properties.description: Drives propose_heal and apply_heal on in-memory designs, editing the proposal as JSON the way an MCP client sends it back, and once more over the served path (call_tool). Pins the rule of dec:the-engine-proposes-a-merge-and-a-person-picks-the-survivor: a merge carries both candidates ranked with their reasons and a recommendation only on a real difference; a swapped keep/remove or a chosen_survivor keeps the person's pick; a pick outside the pair is refused before any write; a pair tied on everything says "no recommendation: a person must pick" and is refused without chosen_survivor, also when keep/remove are swapped or the survivor block is stripped; the id never decides in either sort order; a withdrawn node never outlives a live one; would_destroy no longer blames the alphabet; and the two recorded cases recommend who:ajs (connections) and the critical requirement (priority).
properties.findings: 2026-10-14 on branch fix/the-engine-proposes-a-merge-and-a-person-picks-the-survivor at 21db7f39c (test files unchanged at 4a67511d3): the_engine_proposes_a_merge_and_a_person_picks_the_survivor.rs 11 passed, 0 failed; a_person_picks_the_merge_survivor_over_mcp.rs 2 passed, 0 failed; the_mcp_surface_only_grows.rs 2 passed against v0.84.0's record; the rest of the workspace green except the find_tools rank ratchet, fixed in 4a67511d3 (5 of 5). Before the fix, on main 1f46299a0 with only the tests added (commit 73eb3a9d0): 10 of 11 FAILED in core (a swapped survivor refused as "not one HEAL proposes", chosen_survivor ignored and the alphabet's pick merged, no survivor block, a tie applied with no pick, the ALPHABET line still served); the round-trip guard passed, as it must; 2 of 2 FAILED over MCP (no survivor block). Measured with the release build on a scratch import of main's design copy, 13 merges: the two recorded cases now recommend who:ajs (connections 1368 against 9) and req:graph_is_the_content_bible (priority critical against medium); 8 same-type pairs are decided by a real difference and 3 wait for a person.
properties.name: A person picks which node a merge keeps
